purpose: Deterministic lookup over a version-pinned mandate table: given supplier/buyer country, transaction type, and transaction date, routes to the applicable e-invoicing regime, format, phase status, and transmission channel. Covers France (PDP, B2B receive obligation live 2026-09-01), Germany (XRechnung), UAE (PINT-AE pilot), Malaysia (MyInvois). Third node of the einvoice-validation-pipeline chain. Zero network, zero PII.
